flag: Still playing T20s, but no longer on a South Africa central contract.

name: Namboori Tilak Varma
rr_fit: Indian left-hander for No. 4 or 5, and he would not take an overseas slot.

name: Tim David
rr_fit: Pure death-overs hitting. Nobody in the current RR batting group has the pressure sample to compare.

name: Tristan Stubbs
rr_fit: Overseas middle-order option, though he would be competing with Ferreira and Pretorius for a slot.

name: Romario Shepherd
rr_fit: Seam-bowling all-rounder who bats at the death. Most of his evidence is T20I (only 44 IPL pressure balls).

name: Shivam Dube
rr_fit: Indian left-hand hitter for overs 12 to 20.

name: Rovman Powell
rr_fit: Another overseas finisher option, but his place in the list is shaky.

name: Rinku Singh
rr_fit: Indian finisher. Good overall numbers, yet positive in only 39% of his pressure matches.

flag: Plays T20s but has been kept out of Tests to manage his back.
rr_fit: The only player in both lists: elite leg-spin plus useful lower-order hitting.

name: Suryakumar Yadav
rr_fit: Indian 360-degree batter who can lift the scoring rate from any position.
